# KOOYING — Zhejiang Kooying Autoparts Co., Ltd.

> Commercial vehicle air disc brake pads, heavy-duty drum brake linings, and wind power friction blocks engineered in Huzhou, Zhejiang, China.

## Verified Entity Profile
- **Legal Entity:** Zhejiang Kooying Autoparts Co., Ltd. (浙江冠英汽车零部件有限公司)
- **Primary Brand:** KOOYING (with domestic & sub-brands GUANLONG 冠隆, XINLAI 新莱, SHENGDIAO 圣雕, SANAN 三安, KANENG 卡能)
- **Founded:** 2006 (Huzhou South Taihu Plant commissioned 2019; RMB 180M investment; 43,000 sqm; 116 automated equipment lines)
- **Annual Capacity:** 15,000,000 sets/year
- **Export Footprint:** 30+ countries across Middle East, Southeast Asia, South America, North America, and Europe
- **Certifications:** IATF 16949:2016 (Quality Austria), ECE R90 (E-Mark), GB5763-2018, CCC (3C)

## Laboratory & Formulation Evidence
- **Compounds:** 3 major formulation series, 30+ asbestos-free friction materials (GY-HD400 carbon-ceramic, N91 nano-mineral eco, GY-CV360 balanced fleet)
- **Testing Equipment:** 2× European Krauss machines, 1× North American Chase tester, 4× constant-speed machines, shear & compressibility rigs
- **400°C Constant-Torque Thickness Wear:** 0.040 mm (vs. 0.085 mm industry reference)
- **Friction Coefficient:** μ 0.35–0.38 across 200°C–400°C+
- **Constant-Speed Mass Wear:** 0.580 g (vs. 0.650 g reference); Impact Strength: 0.340 J/cm²; Hardness: HRM 8.442
